title: Reviewed NEC 110.26 leading conditions now preserve exact condition evidence in generic Provision AST
description: Merged PR #332 carries all six reviewed clause-leading NEC 110.26 condition/applicability spans through a publication-neutral source_text condition expression with exact reviewed evidence and provenance, without claiming semantic decomposition. Unsupported mappings remain fail-closed.
author: bcast

rationale: The landed reviewed dependency projection exposed the fail-closed condition boundary that PR #332 then made representable without introducing an NEC-specific semantic model.
author: bcast

rationale: The new generic condition-evidence capability advances the active goal of increasing reviewed engineering meaning while leaving subsequent semantic families to exact-source evidence.
author: bcast

title: AISC recovery now resolves retained source identity through the canonical object namespace
description: Merged PR #330 replaces the raw provider-coordinate seam with canonical object-v1 identity for the retained ANSI/AISC 360-16 derivative, documents the canonical private recovery child namespace, and preserves fail-closed digest verification before any payload can become private_retrievable.
author: bcast

rationale: Exact retained-source authority now uses a canonical logical object coordinate rather than a private provider locator in durable AISC recovery evidence.
author: bcast

rationale: Canonical retained-object resolution strengthens the existing fail-closed recovery contract while keeping the private-payload promotion gate closed until an authoritative digest-matching child object exists.
author: bcast
